answer:
Your Projects note is now a kanban board app. I only checked it in screenshots at phone and Mac widths in light mode, so drag and drop and the card editor haven't been tried. The screenshots show the boards, columns and cards rendering correctly.

- **Boards and columns:** You can add, rename and delete boards from the board tabs and the ⋯ menu. New boards start with To do, Doing and Done. Each column's ⋯ menu lets you rename it, move it left or right, or delete it. Cards in a deleted column move to the first remaining column.
- **Cards:** Type a title in the "Add a card…" field under any column and press Enter to add it. Tapping a card opens an editor for title, description, due date, labels, checklist and column. The editor also has Archive and Delete.
- **Moving cards:** On the Mac you drag cards between columns and to reorder them. On the phone, the ⇄ button on each card opens a "Move to" list, plus Move up and Move down.
- **Search and filters:** You can search by title, description, label or checklist text, filter by label, and show only overdue cards. Overdue cards show in red.
- **Archive:** "Archive done" archives every card in the last column. The ⋯ menu next to the board tabs opens the archive, where you can restore or delete cards.
- **Demo data:** Two boards, "Website relaunch" and "Home & life", with seven cards each. They have labels, checklists, and a few overdue and upcoming due dates.

The last column of each board counts as "done". Overdue ignores it, and "Archive done" archives it.

The automated checks still flag colour contrast on the board tabs and label chips, and two fields without a visible border. I tightened the label colours but didn't fix the rest.

The seed data is generated when the app first opens, so data.json stays empty until you change something.
